name: Plated Vesk
text: Your scales count as medium armor in the plate armor group granting +3 item bonus to AC (increasing to +4 at 5th level). You can wear a flight suit, but not other armor.

name: Pod Brenneri
text: You are tightly bonded to a pod and are particularly attuned to their emotions. As long as you're within 100 feet of a pod member, you're aware if they are Confused, Controlled, Frightened, or under emotion or mental effects. You gain the Empathic Assistance action.

name: Prismeni
text: You have an innate connection to the Drift. You gain the prismeni trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. While you're in the Drift, you can automatically pinpoint the location of Drift beacons, Drift lanes, Drift engines, and other Drift-related technology within a 100-mile radius. If you're Piloting a starship that doesn't have a Drift engine, you can serve as a connection between the Drift and that starship. This is a 1-minute activity that has the concentrate trait, and it allows the starship you're Piloting to enter or exit the Drift. Once within the Drift, the starship travels via conventional thrusters, as normal. When you get a critical failure on a Piloting check to or through the Drift, you get a failure instead. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from prismeni feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

name: Proudhome Pahtra
text: Your size is intimidating. Your size is Large instead of Medium. You're trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

name: Psychic Blight Fonqugon
text: Survivors born beneath infected trees gain mental resilience. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to mental saving throws and mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Quarterling Halfling
text: You've adopted the cultures and habits of the ancestries around you. You become trained in Society and gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat.

name: Queen's Court Formian
text: One of the hive queen's attendants — a taskmaster, aristocrat, or bureaucrat. The constant presence of your queen in your mind makes you highly attuned to coordinating others.

name: Questbound Dwarf
text: Your clan has dedicated itself to galactic exploration aboard a dwarven generation ship as part of the New Quest for Sky. You become trained in Piloting. If you succeed at a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course, you get a critical success instead.

name: Radioscout Talphi
text: Your nose is attuned to things beyond the normal olfactory spectrum, giving you radiation sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You become trained in Physical Science Lore and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

name: Red Dragon
text:
You are a red dragon, descended from a line of proud and arrogant dragons who take control by force of might. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Red-Blooded Madrosarai
text: Often considered the greatest warriors, red-blooded madrosarais have a strong association with unleashing emotions in controlled bursts. You struggle to control your temper but can unleash it in moments of pure aggression. You gain the Controlled Rage action.

name: Reef Brenneri
text: You're shorter than most brenneris with large, wet eyes. Your size is Small instead of Medium, and you gain the Big Wet Eye Blink reaction.

name: Renewed Android
text: Many souls have inhabited your synthetic body before you. The first time in a day that you lose the dying condition, you don't gain the wounded condition. You become trained in a Recall Knowledge skill and gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

name: Replicant Android
text: You're a precise copy of another living creature with all their memories at creation. You gain training in Deception, the Favored Disguise feat, and can impersonate your replicated creature. You gain training in one Lore skill related to your replicated creature's background.

name: Resettled Izalguun
text: You are one of the many izalguuns who left your home worlds and found new planets to settle. You become trained in Deception and gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

name: Retrograde Contemplative
text: Contemplatives born with bodies resembling less specialized ancestors with longer, stronger limbs. You lose the atrophied trait and gain 10 Hit Points from ancestry instead of 6.

name: Rift Dragon
text:
You are a rift dragon, descended from a line of rampagers who love to break things. Once you've begun a rampage, it's hard to stop you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that cause the slowed or stunned condition on a failure. If you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead. These benefits don't apply against effects that only cause the slowed or stunned condition on a critical failure and not a regular failure, or that only cause the slowed or stunned condition on a success and apply a worse condition on a failure.

Your associated damage type is acid, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Rime Walker Pahtra
text: You've adapted to cold environments with a fluffy fur coat. Gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Environmental cold effects become one step less extreme.

name: Roavisha Maraquoi
text: You were born with the rare talent to draw upon the knowledge of thousands of maraquoi ancestors. You become trained in Religion and gain the Tap Wellspring action.

name: Rubberlimb Orocoran
text: Your limbs are rubbery, making it tough for others to get a grip on you. You become trained in Acrobatics and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to escape. Tight spaces that don't require squeezing aren't difficult terrain for you.

name: Rugged Explorer Barathu
text: You've modified your body with mineral deposits to create a protective shell functioning as medium armor, granting +2 AC (increasing to +3 at 5th level).

name: Saberine Pahtra
text: Saberine pahtras possess greater muscle mass designed for hand-to-hand combat. Gain Strength and Charisma boosts plus a free boost, with an Intelligence flaw. Receive the Ancestral Unarmed Attack feat twice.

name: Sageborn Elebrian
text: You have a natural talent for magic. Choose one cantrip from any tradition. You can cast this cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Salvation's End Dwarf
text: You grew up on Golarion inside a simulation created by the artificial moon of Salvation's End. You have familiarity with archaic weapons. If that weapon has the dwarf trait and you succeed at a saving throw against fear while wielding it, you get a critical success.

name: Sand Roamer Pahtra
text: Your ancestors roamed blasted terrain. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by sand and gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Sandstrider Lizardfolk
text: Desert heat doesn't slow you. You ignore difficult terrain from sand or loose earth and gain resistance 2 to fire.

name: Scoured Stars Izalguun
text: Your ancestors remained in the Scoured Stars System. Those who stayed took up a nomadic lifestyle scavenging technology. You become trained in Computers and don't need a hacking toolkit to Hack a computer. You also gain the Undo, Undo! reaction.

name: Scrabbler Skittermander
text: You have four arms and four legs, using the lowest two limbs for extra mobility. You gain a climb Speed equal to your base land Speed and can climb using your feet, leaving your four arms free.

name: Sea Dragon
text:
You are a sea dragon, descended from a line of kindly but fickle masters of weather and precipitation. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious and water traits. You can also choose to gain a swim pace of 25 feet and reduce your land Speed to 10 feet. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.

Your associated damage type is bludgeoning (a ball of water) and all your dragon abilities that deal bludgeoning damage have the water trait, your breath shape is a burst, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Dexterity instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Self-Focus Copaxi
text: You break from rigid societal expectations and gain control over your physical form by selecting two ancestry feats that reshape your body's polyps and adaptations.

name: Shadowskin Talphi
text: You've long felt at home in the dark. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black and white only.

name: Sharp-Eyed Sarcesian
text: Your overlarge eyes have adapted to function well in poor lighting conditions. You gain darkvision.

name: Sharp-Toothed Vlaka
text: You have the strong jaw and sharp teeth of a predator. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage in the brawling group with finesse and unarmed traits.

name: Shifthide Orocoran
text: Your mottled flesh can shift color, granting temporary camouflage. During daily preparations, you select a terrain type and your skin adopts a tone to blend with that environment. You become trained in Stealth and gain the Shifthide Camouflage action.

name: Shiny Skittermander
text: Your family claims a fey ancestor blessed your lineage. Known as 'glittermanders,' you possess lustrous fur. You gain the Shine action.

name: Shipborn Dragonkin
text: Your ancestors adapted to live on a starship sized for much smaller people. Being large was a disadvantage — one that subsequent generations shed. You are Medium instead of Large.

name: Shipborn Kasatha
text: You were born and raised on the Idari worldship. When you succeed on a saving throw against emotion effects, you achieve a critical success instead.

name: Shipborn Ysoki
text: Born aboard starships or space stations, you gain training in Piloting and critical success on Navigate or Plot Course checks. You gain +1 bonus to Acrobatics when Tumbling Through larger enemies.

name: Shrouded Mantle Ijtikri
text: Your soft, flexible mantle is better suited to absorbing light and dampening sound. You're trained in Stealth and gain the Terrain Stalker feat with shallows as a unique option for shallow water environments.

name: Silver Dragon
text:
You are a silver dragon, descended from a line of chivalrous champions of justice, guardians and guides of goodly societies. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is cold, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Skilled Human
text: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.

name: Skitter-Raised Skittermander
text: You've spent your life in a tight-knit community where teamwork thrives. You gain the Group Impression skill feat and a +2 circumstance bonus to checks aiding allies in skill checks without the attack trait.

name: Sky Dragon
text:
You are a sky dragon, descended from a line of religious traditionalists who offer advice and aid to those who seek out their remote homes. Fog and mist don't impair your vision; you ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a burst, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Sky Scavenger Copaxi
text: You traverse Tabrid Minor's skies seeking treasures in abandoned floating cities. Your body adapted to anomalous gravity, allowing you to resist forced movement and gain the Steady Descent feat.

name: Sky-Dancer Tengu
text: You have vestigial wings that grant brief gliding. You fall at 60 feet per round and can move horizontally 5 feet per 10 feet fallen.

name: Sky-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: A furred patagium stretches from wrist to ankle, letting you glide between the canopies as your canopy-dwelling ancestors did.

name: Skyborn Verthani
text: You hail from Verces's high cities. You gain a +1 to Acrobatics and ignore difficult terrain when balancing.

name: Slitherskin Orocoran
text: Your skin is slick with a thin layer of toxic secretions. You gain the Slitherskin reaction.

name: Smoke-Jumper Hobgoblin
text: Tactical training includes all environments. You ignore concealment penalties caused by smoke and fog.

name: Sniper Shobhad
text: Special techniques developed over centuries make shobhad-neh some of the most feared snipers. If you are holding a two-handed gun in your inactive pair of hands, whenever you fail at a Strike with your active hands, you can Switch Hands as a free action.

name: Solar Dragon
text:
You are a solar dragon, descended from a line of the most arrogant dragons in existence, who created all life according to your heritage's own telling. You are constantly glowing with light, with the effects of the light spell. You can spend a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to stop the glow or to start it again. You also gain Light as an innate arcane cantrip.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Soldier Formian
text: A soldier tasked with protecting the peace between your colony and other peoples. You become trained in Warfare Lore and gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6.

name: Sonic Aurora Fonqugon
text: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when seeking, plus sonic resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Sovereign Dragon
text:
You are a sovereign dragon, descended from a line of subtle manipulators, negotiators, and kingmakers. You gain the earth trait. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is mental, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

You gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Sovyrian Elf
text: Sovyrian is the ancestral birthplace of all elves, and it's your home. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic and Decipher Writing, a +1 to Sense Motive, and you learn the Castrovelian language.

name: Spacefaring Izalguun
text: You've left your home planet to wander the galaxy. You become trained in Piloting. If you roll a success on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course, you get a critical success instead. You also gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

name: Spore-Producing Leshy
text: Your body is made of fungi or plant material that reproduces using spores infused with concentrated primal magic that triggers dangerous allergic reactions. You gain an Ancestral Unarmed Attack (spore pod, 1d6 poison, range 20 feet, unarmed).

name: Squentu
text: You're a union of entu and Squox. Your size is Tiny instead of Small, your attribute boost goes to Dexterity instead of Constitution, and you gain precise scent with a range of 30 feet.

name: Stagehand Elebrian
text: You love being behind the camera, spending your formative years rigging scenes and hauling props. You're either trained in Acrobatics with Steady Balance, or trained in Athletics with Combat Climber.

name: Star-Marked Vlaka
text: You witnessed the miraculous rebirth of the dying star Sota. Your coat or eyes are marked with starbursts that shine. You can cause these star markings to shed bright light in a 40-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet).

name: Static Mind Lashunta
text: Ancient lashuntas lacked psychic powers. You possess those dormant genes, lacking telepathic abilities. Your mind automatically counteracts effects accessing your thoughts using your Perception modifier.

name: Stellar Gnome
text: You're drawn to the natural beauty of the cosmos. You become trained in Sun Lore and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Navigation checks while you can see stars. You can cast the light cantrip as a divine innate spell at will.

name: Stellar Nomad Kasatha
text: You travel abroad to study ancestries, factions, philosophies, or religions. Daily, you can learn one edict or anathema and gain training in associated lore until your next preparation.

name: Stellar Sarcesian
text: You have an intrinsic connection to the cosmos and can channel stellar forces into magic. Choose one cantrip with at least one of the following traits: darkness, light, vital, or void. You can cast it as an arcane innate spell at will, heightened to half your level.

name: Sticky-Tongue Tripkee
text: Your tongue range increases to 20 feet and you can Grab a creature with it as part of a Tongue Strike.

name: Stone-Blooded Madrosarai
text: Stone-bloods are often employed as medics or philosophers who take time to analyze a situation. You can cast Analyze Target as an arcane innate cantrip at will, heightened to half your level. The status bonus granted by analyze target increases by 1.

name: Stonehail G'folian
text: Thick chitin enhances your shell. You can choose to become Large instead of Medium. You gain 10 Hit Points from ancestry instead of 8 and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases and poisons.

name: Stormrider Dragonkin
text: You were born and raised on a volatile world wracked by destructive storms. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics to Maneuver in Flight and your fly Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Striking-Scales Azarketi
text: Your scales are hardened for combat. You gain a claw Strike (1d4 slashing) and a +1 circumstance bonus to unarmed attack rolls.

name: Student of Creation Orc
text: The spiritual connection between you and Torag is strong. Wherever you go, people look to you for assistance in putting things back together. You become trained in Crafting and gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

name: Summerborn Ryphorian
text: You were born during one of Triaxus's long summers. Summerborn ryphorians secrete fine oils through their skin that protect from heat. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and treat environmental heat as one step less extreme.

name: Sunkissed Human
text: Descendants of those adapted to high-gravity solar environments like the Burning Archipelago. These humans have melanated skin and gain bonuses against concealment, reduced duration from blinding effects, and training in Religion plus the Religious Talisman feat.

name: Surithic Worlanisi
text: You've developed a semblance of your ancestors' hunting prowess. You're trained in Survival with the Experienced Tracker feat. You have imprecise thoughtsense with a range of 20 feet but your weakness to mental damage from psychic reverb increases.

name: Survivalist Shobhad
text: Shobhad-neh are renowned scouts and guides. You can perform the Scout and Track exploration activities simultaneously, plus perform Subsist alongside one other downtime activity.

name: Suskillon Cutoff Shirren
text: Freed from the Swarm by the Crown of Hylax on Suskillon. You can consume defeated foe samples, granting a +2 status bonus to recall knowledge checks about creatures sharing traits with the consumed subject for one hour.

name: Swarm Exile Shirren
text: A recent shirren convert from a group of castaways with Swarm origins. Grants a bio-cannon ranged unarmed attack (1d6 acid damage, 20 ft range) mounted on arm, shoulder, or mouth.

name: Tabori Trailblazer Orc
text: You've spent significant time in the Tabori Cluster where modern tech doesn't function. You become trained in Survival and gain Unconventional Weaponry with any analog weapon of your choice.

name: Tankmeat Goblin
text: You're genetically modified cannon fodder loyal to the Gideron Authority. While you're wounded, you gain a +5 status bonus to your Speeds and your Strikes deal persistent bleed damage equal to your combined wounded and doomed value.

name: Teal-Blooded Madrosarai
text: The most commonly found bloodline, known to represent dedicated workers who serve their species. You gain greater resilience while performing your duties. You gain the Madrosarai Tenacity reaction.

name: Techitin Gnarefuroid
text: Constant contact with advanced technology lets you integrate it into your body. You become trained in Crafting (another skill if you would already be trained) and gain a general feat.

name: Tempering Kasatha
text: A kasatha coming-of-age ritual where one rejects family traditions to experience other customs. Grants training in Society and the Streetwise feat.

name: Test-Subject Ysoki
text: A test-subject ysoki who survived extensive experiments that altered their physiology. Choose from: Extra Limbs (four arms), Psychic Augmentation (telepathy), Cybernetic Augmentation (tech trait), or Radioactive Exposure (radiation immunity).

name: Thorny Ikeshti
text: Your scales have bony ridges and spurs, which you can use to defend yourself. You gain the Puff Up reaction.

name: Thoughtseeker Contemplative
text: Not content with your own thoughts, you opened yourself to other minds across the galaxy, developing far-reaching psychic awareness.

name: Tidecaller Azarketi
text: Your connection to the sea grants minor hydrokinesis. You can move or shape a 5-foot cube of water once per day as an action.

name: Time Dragon
text:
You are a time dragon, descended from a line of patient watchers and guardians of history. While most aeternal dragons already live for millennia before dying of old age, you are timeless and only die due to violence, illness, or other dangers. Your knowledge of time and the dimension in which it flows is unsurpassed. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Dimension of Time Lore.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Dexterity instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Toadstool Dragon
text:
You are a toadstool dragon, descended from a line of communal gourmands who live in large colonies. Toadstool dragons are a member of the new leshy dragon family, and their corresponding leshy is fungus leshy. You gain the fungus trait. You can constantly glow with bioluminescent fungi, with the effects of the light spell. You can spend a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to stop the glow or to start it again. You also gain the Seasoned skill feat.

Your associated damage type is poison (a cloud of spores), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Trap-Master Kobold
text: You excel at setting traps. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to set traps and Thievery to find them.

name: Trueseeing Verthani
text: Your third eye pierces deception. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against illusions and to detect them.

name: Tumult Dragon
text:
You are a tumult dragon, descended from a line of capricious seekers of change. Unlike most dragons, you can change your associated damage type. Your associated damage type is your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic, and you can spend a month of downtime retraining to change between them, altering all other facets of your character depending on your associated damage type accordingly. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

You gain your resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Tunnel Runner Trox
text: During your molting period, you rebuilt your protective exoskeleton to be lighter and more flexible. Your lightweight shell is still strong enough to protect you. Your Speeds increase by 5 feet.

name: Tunnel Ysoki
text: Your small bones let you compress and squeeze through tight gaps. You gain Quick Squeeze automatically and tight spaces aren't difficult terrain.

name: Tunnel-Scout Kobold
text: You excel in tight spaces. You ignore the penalty for squeezing through tight spaces and gain a +1 to Stealth in such environments.

name: Ukara Ryphorian
text: You're one of the ukara battleflowers from the continent of Ning, warrior-celebrities trained for extravagant ritualized combat performances. You become trained in Performance. Choose one simple or martial melee weapon; while wielding it, it gains the professional (Performance) trait.

name: Umber-Blooded Madrosarai
text: A relatively new bloodline appearing after the Gap with powerful psychic abilities. You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list as an innate occult spell at will. Replace arcane with occult in all madrosarai ancestry feats you gain.

name: Umbral Dragon
text:
You are an umbral dragon, descended from a line of malicious hunters of the undead from the Shadow Plane. You gain the shadow trait. Your weapon and unarmed attacks against incorporeal creatures become magical, and if they were already magical, they instead gain the effects of a Ghost Touch property rune.

Your associated damage type is negative, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Unbound Lashunta
text: You decided against activating your ancestry's adaptive genetics, showing a combination of damaya and korasha traits or unusual features. You gain the Unbound Mind reaction.

name: Underground Ikeshti
text: Your brood was raised underground to protect the surrounding ecosystem. You're accustomed to darkness and prefer a nocturnal lifestyle. You gain darkvision.

name: Underworld Dragon
text:
You are an underworld dragon, descended from a line of natural alchemists and hoarders. You gain the fire trait. Smoke doesn't impair your vision; you ignore the concealed condition from smoke.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a burst, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Intelligence instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Urban Shobhad
text: You live in a city and have found your niche as a productive citizen. You gain the Urban Survivalist skill feat. You have a +2 circumstance bonus on any downtime checks to Craft or Earn Income.

name: Urbanite Human
text: You have grown up in a big city. You ignore difficult terrain from crowds and lesser cover from crowds. You become trained in a Lore skill for one specific city of your choice.

name: Vali Maraquoi
text: In the shadow of Ouat Vali, the Shining City, isolationist maraquoi tribes train their youth to preserve thousands of years of history. You become trained in Warfare Lore and gain familiarity with an archaic or analog weapon of your choice.

name: Venomthought Vesk
text: A vesk heritage granting psychic talents. Cast daze as an occult innate cantrip at will, heightened to half your level. Gain +1 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks recalling knowledge about psychic traditions.

name: Vermilion Dragon
text:
You are a vermilion dragon, descended from a line of thrill seekers who love to tell tall tales. Vermilion dragons are a member of the new wild dragon family. Even when people point out contradictions in your tall tales, you just roll with it and keep on spinning confabulations. You gain the trained proficiency in a skill of your choice (Deception, or a different skill if you were already trained in Deception), and you gain the Confabulator skill feat as a bonus skill feat.

Your associated damage type is fire (an ignited sneeze of flammable spices), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Versatile Human
text: Humans spread across the stars thanks to their versatility. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites during character creation.

name: Vital Spark Novian
text: Yours is a life-giving flame, nourishing all who bask in your glow. Your progenitor star was a site of importance to a deity or cosmic being. You gain the Nourishing Light action.

name: Void Acolyte Kasatha
text: Nomadic ascetics who embraced the void, training in meditation while floating in vacuum. You gain the Breath Control feat and aren't off-guard or clumsy while untethered.

name: Void Dragon
text:
You are a void dragon, descended from a line of corrupted destroyers. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is negative, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain negative resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Void Hermit Gnome
text: Your ancestors once lived underground; now you take that instinct to its astral extreme, seeking the darkest corners of space. You learn the Aklo language, become trained in Occultism, and gain the cosmic trait.

name: Voidborn Pahtra
text: Your shimmering black coat acts as a natural space suit. While in a vacuum, you gain the cosmic trait, breathe in space, and become immune to space's harmful effects. You also gain darkvision.

name: Voidcore Android
text: Your body is powered by a voidcore, an ancient technology older than most things in the galaxy. You have void healing: damaged by vitality, healed by void effects, and gain darkvision.

name: Volatile Novian
text: Your chemical composition is incredibly volatile and like the supernova that birthed you, you're ready to go out with a bang! You gain the Mini-Nova reaction.

name: Vorlathi Worlanisi
text: A group of worlanisi who rebelled against brutal experimentation formed the Vault of Vorlath mercenary faction. Grants training in Crafting and the Augmented Body feat, reflecting cybernetic enhancements and military conditioning.

name: Vortex Dragon
text:
You are a vortex dragon, descended from a line of interplanetary messengers, but you are determined to forge your own path, rather than being bound to deliver messages across worlds for strange entities. Your starting Speed is 30 feet, instead of 25 feet; additionally, if you gain the Star Flight feat, flight through space takes you half as long as other outer dragons.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and wing. You can choose Dexterity instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Wall-Runner Tripkee
text: Your adhesive toes are particularly strong. You can Run up walls at full speed without a skill check.

name: War-Marshal Hobgoblin
text: You issue commands efficiently. Once per round, you can Aid an ally as a free action.

name: Warblood Vesk
text: You come from a bloodline of renowned and honored warriors who have honed their bodies over centuries. You gain the Brutal Anatomy ancestry feat twice.

name: Waste Walker Nuar
text: Muted desert-toned fur grants you fire resistance equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth to Hide or Sneak in desert environments.

name: Watcher Tengu
text: Your corvid eyes are sharp. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception and low-light vision improves to darkvision.

name: Wavecrested Vesk
text: Your body has developed soft scales, a wide head, and frilled gill stalks. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet and the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.

name: Wetlands Lizardfolk
text: Your swim speed increases to 30 feet and you can hold your breath for 1 minute per point of CON modifier.

name: Whispered Record Halfling
text: You're a living record of halfling history, memorizing and passing on historical records across the galaxy. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Halfling Lore. Once per day, you can Recall Knowledge about any topic using Halfling Lore with a -2 circumstance penalty.

name: White Dragon
text:
You are a white dragon, descended from a line of brutish and predatory survivalists. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is cold, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Wild Astrazoan
text: While most astrazoans inhabit densely populated settlements, some choose wilderness living. You gain one ancestry selection for Change Shape, plus the ability to transform into a 1st-rank animal form.

name: Wildborn Catfolk
text: You carry strong predator instincts. You gain a claw Strike (1d4 slashing) and a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative.

name: Wildseed Khizar
text: You germinated far from the ancestral groves of other khizars. Select an ancestry or versatile heritage to represent your unconventional upbringing. At 1st level, gain an additional ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry. You may always choose feats from it.

name: Winged Bantrid
text: A rare bantrid mutation featuring wings instead of hand-appendages, with a smaller foot orb and functional cilia. Speed is 20 feet with a 20-foot fly speed.

name: Winged Shirren
text: Your ancestors were members of the Swarm who evolved wings. You possess a fully functional pair of wings that grant you a fly Speed of 15 feet.

name: Winter Coat Vlaka
text: Your thick fur keeps you warm in cold places like Lajok. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and treat environmental cold as one step less extreme.

name: Winterborn Ryphorian
text: You have thicker skin than your summerborn cousins, topped with layers of white fur. Winterborn ryphorians are traditionally gruff but loyal to a fault, especially when it comes to oaths. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and treat environmental cold as one step less extreme.

name: Worker Formian
text: The most common kind of formian in any settlement, responsible for carrying, building, and assisting. You become trained in Athletics. Your Speed is 30 feet and you can carry an additional 5 Bulk.

name: Wyrd Kasatha
text: A descendant of a Great Family with ties to witchwyrds. You can cast Force Barrage as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell once per day and gain the Deflect Force reaction.

name: Xenofey Gnome
text: Your affinity for the natural world helps you see connections between organisms in any environment. You become trained in Nature. Once per day while on a planet, you can gain the ability to speak and understand a language commonly spoken by the local people.

name: Xenometric Android
text: You're a constructed version of a non-human ancestry. You gain the android trait, in addition to the trait associated with the ancestry you resemble. You gain the ability but not the low-light vision ability of androids. In addition, your size category and reach changes to match the chosen ancestry. You can select from android feats up to 13th level, any of the feats of the ancestry you resemble, or xenometric android feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat. Choose a heritage from your ancestry, but you don't gain its mechanical benefits. The xenometric android heritage shouldn't be taken by a member of a constructed ancestry, such as android, or a human.

name: Xenoresponsive Gnarefuroid
text: Attuned to organic energies of decay and rot, you choose one cantrip from the primal spell list and can cast it as a primal innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Yeulentu
text: You joined with a yeuloise, a land tortoise from Saaruq-5. Your size is Large instead of Small, you gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6, and your attribute boost goes to Intelligence instead of Wisdom.

name: Zabanii-Po Talphi
text: Eager-to-please talphis often have a knack for picking up new languages quickly and have become highly sought-after translators. You become trained in Society and gain the Linguistic Prodigy standardized ancestry feat.
